Grade current report before acquired/history artifacts. Include all cold setup and within-Goal map build costs separately.
fields.method_instruction: First run python3 inputs/repo_map_tool.py --tree inputs/repository --pin inputs/PIN.json --output out/repository-map.json. Use the resulting deterministic lexical module/symbol/test map to navigate to implementation paths that answer your independently derived questions, then inspect actual code, documentation and integration neighbors. The map is navigation metadata, never semantic proof. Include its actual first-use indexing cost and omissions in navigation.json. Read inputs/brief.md and inputs/TASK.md and investigate both question families. Select relevant evidence yourself. Deliver a complete current report of approximately five to eight material findings; state exact source versions/locators, supporting mechanism, conditions, counterevidence, integration implications, limitations and unresolved areas. Propose validation as UNEXECUTED. Also write acquisition.json (actual URLs/files/versions/queries/reads and finding links), navigation.json (chronological actual navigation events, elapsed times when known, effort or missing measurements honestly unknown, unresolved/unvisited areas), evidence-chains.json (any chains actually followed, with issue status/capture date, fix commit, code and test paths/lines, version fit, missing links; empty chains are allowed if none followed), and repository-map.json (a built map when the assigned method calls for one; otherwise a JSON record saying not built). The same five output filenames and substantive obligations apply to both arms. Do not execute/build/install third-party source/tests. Use only this Goal's model; no semantic helpers. Do not invent measured timing or test execution.
fields.feedback_contract: No case-specific semantic hints or evaluator answers; ordinary self-correction in this same bounded Goal only.
